[[File:CorSec_Special_Ops_Captain.png|thumb|right|160px|A CorSec Special Ops Captain]]
The '''Special Operations Unit''',<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Corellian Security Force (CorSec)}}</ref> also known as '''CorSec Special Operations''',<ref name="XWTBW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref> or just '''CorSec Special Ops''',<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> was a famous unit in the [[Corellian Security Force]], the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It existed as early as the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]],<ref name="Codex" /> and was still in activity during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="XWTBW" /> The unit enlisted some of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] best specialists in undercover infiltration, and its members were tasked with infiltrating criminal organizations and bringing them down from inside.<ref name="Codex" /> Another of their areas of expertise was raids on criminal strongholds.<ref name="XWTBW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The CorSec Special Operations was first mentioned in the novel ''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''.<ref name="XWTBW" /> It first appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" /> The Special Operations Unit was also mentioned in the Codex entry for the Corellian Security Force in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
